story_info.title: Toby Turtle Helps a Tiny Beetle
story_info.subtitle: A kind helper in Sunny Forest
story_info.moral: It is good to care for nature and all its small friends.

main_character.name: Toby Turtle
main_character.appearance: Toby is a young sea turtle with a rounded teal-green shell patterned in soft swirls, gentle brown eyes, and smooth blue-green flippers. He has a calm, unhurried expression.

cover.prompt: Pixar-quality 3D style, warm cinematic lighting, children's book illustration, vertical composition, Instagram friendly. A young sea turtle named Toby, with a rounded teal-green shell patterned in soft swirls, gentle brown eyes, and smooth blue-green flippers, showing a calm expression, gently helping a tiny green beetle on a large green leaf in a sunny forest clearing. slides.title: A Walk in the Forest
slides.text: Toby Turtle walked in Sunny Forest. The sun was warm and bright. He heard birds sing sweet songs. Toby looked at all the green trees. "Slow and steady discovers wonders!" he said. He loved his morning walks.
slides.speaker_notes: Introduce Toby and the Sunny Forest setting. Show Toby enjoying nature.

slides.title: Pretty Forest Friends
slides.text: Toby saw pretty flowers. They were red, yellow, and blue. A tiny butterfly flew past his nose. It danced in the air. Toby smiled a big, happy smile. He loved seeing all the forest life.
slides.speaker_notes: Show Toby observing the colorful flowers and a butterfly. Emphasize his joy.

slides.title: A Little Friend Needs Help
slides.text: Then Toby saw something small. It was a little green beetle. The beetle was on its back! It wiggled its tiny legs. It tried hard to turn over. But it could not do it alone.
slides.speaker_notes: Introduce the small challenge: a beetle in distress. Toby notices it.

slides.title: Toby's Gentle Idea
slides.text: Toby moved very slowly. He found a big green leaf. He gently slid the leaf near the beetle. "You can do it, little friend," he said softly. The beetle crawled onto the leaf.
slides.speaker_notes: Show Toby's gentle approach and creative solution using a leaf.

slides.title: A Happy Thank You
slides.text: Toby carefully lifted the leaf. He turned it over. Plop! The beetle was on its feet. It wiggled its antennae. Then it scurried away quickly. Toby felt very happy inside. He helped a tiny creature. It is good to care for nature.
slides.speaker_notes: The resolution: the beetle is safe. Toby feels proud and happy. Reiterate the moral.

instagram.caption: Toby Turtle loves his morning walks in Sunny Forest. He enjoys seeing all the beautiful flowers and happy birds. But one day, he finds a tiny friend in trouble. A little beetle is stuck on its back! Will Toby use his gentle nature to help? This sweet story shows how even small actions can make a big difference. It teaches children to be kind to all creatures and protect our amazing nature. Share this with a parent who loves nature adventures! #Bedtime01Fables #TobyTurtle #KidsNature #ForestFriends #KindnessMatters
